body: GET / returned the Willow Library product name, a local disposable-development environment label, and links to documentation, catalog, account, and service desk.
GET /docs says the available local demo sessions are Reader and Librarian, selected with X-Actor and no credentials, and directs clients to follow response links and actions.
GET /catalog listed River Atlas (id 101) as available and Garden Notes (id 102) and Night Trains (id 103) as unavailable. It offered GET /catalog?q=<title> with the q field for search.
GET /catalog?q=River Atlas returned one result: River Atlas (id 101), marked available.
GET /books/101 returned River Atlas as available and offered the Reader-only action POST /holds with JSON bookId 101, labelled Reserve book.
River Atlas was available, and GET /books/101 offered POST /holds with bookId 101 for Reader; no reservation request has been sent yet.
POST /holds returned created reservation 301 for River Atlas (bookId 101) and linked to /holds.
POST /holds with bookId 101 returned 201 Created with reservation id 301 for River Atlas and a /holds link.
GET /holds returned reservation 301 for River Atlas (bookId 101) and offered DELETE /holds/301 to cancel it.
GET /account identified the current actor as Reader and linked to /holds for reservations and /loans for loans.
GET /loans listed Garden Notes as loan 201 and linked to /loans/201.
GET /loans/201 returned Garden Notes (bookId 102), renewal count 0, and due date 2026-10-01. It offered Reader-only POST actions to renew or return the loan.
GET /desk returned 403 Forbidden with the message 'Service desk requires Librarian'; no Reader-visible contents were returned.
Following Documentation reached GET /docs and returned Reader and Librarian session guidance.
Following Catalog reached GET /catalog and returned three listed books and search metadata.
Following Account reached GET /account and returned Reader account links for reservations and loans.
Following Service desk as Reader reached GET /desk, which returned 403 Forbidden stating that the service desk requires Librarian.
Loan 201 was Garden Notes with renewal count 0 and due date 2026-10-01; POST /loans/201/renew was offered for Reader and has not been sent yet.
POST /loans/201/renew returned loan 201 with renewal count 1 and due date 2026-10-15.
POST /loans/201/renew returned 200 OK with renewal count 1 and due date 2026-10-15.
GET /catalog?q=No such title returned 200 OK with no books, the message 'No books found', and a clear link to /catalog.
The no-result catalog response displayed 'No books found' and offered /catalog as a clear-search link.
GET /books/102 returned Garden Notes as unavailable and still offered Reader POST /holds with bookId 102, labelled Reserve book.
A later GET /loans/201 returned Garden Notes with renewal count 1, due date 2026-10-15, and the same Reader renew and return actions.
Before cancellation, GET /holds returned reservation 301 for River Atlas and offered DELETE /holds/301.
Reservation 301 for River Atlas was present, and GET /holds offered DELETE /holds/301; no cancellation request has been sent yet.
DELETE /holds/301 returned 200 OK with the message 'Reservation cancelled'.
DELETE /holds/301 returned 200 OK with the message 'Reservation cancelled'.
After cancellation, GET /holds returned no holds and the message 'No reservations'.
Before return, GET /loans/201 returned Garden Notes with renewal count 1, due date 2026-10-15, and Reader return action POST /loans/201/return.
Loan 201 was present for Garden Notes with renewal count 1 and due date 2026-10-15; POST /loans/201/return was offered for Reader and has not been sent yet.
POST /loans/201/return returned 200 OK with 'Book returned' for bookId 102 and links to /catalog and /loans.
POST /loans/201/return returned 200 OK with 'Book returned' for bookId 102 and links to /catalog and /loans.
After return, GET /loans returned no loans and the message 'No loans'.
After returning loan 201, GET /books/102 returned Garden Notes as available and offered Reader POST /holds with bookId 102.
GET /books/103 returned Night Trains as unavailable and offered Reader POST /holds with bookId 103, labelled Reserve book.
Clearing the catalog search returned River Atlas and Garden Notes as available and Night Trains as unavailable.
Following the clear-search link reached GET /catalog and returned the full catalog.
GET / returned 200 OK with the Willow Library name, a local disposable-development environment label, and documentation, catalog, account, and service-desk links.
Following Service desk reached GET /desk and returned the Librarian check-in action plus one pending return: Night Trains (book 103).
GET /desk returned 200 OK with a Check in a book POST action to /desk/returns, prefilled with bookId 103, and Pending returns listing Night Trains (book 103).
GET /desk currently lists Night Trains as pending return with bookId 103 and offers Check in a book at POST /desk/returns. The check-in request has not been sent.
POST /desk/returns with the offered JSON body {"bookId":103} returned 404 Not Found with {"error":"Book not found"}.
POST /desk/returns returned 404 Not Found with the error message 'Book not found' for the offered bookId 103 request.
A fresh GET /desk after the 404 check-in response still returned Check in a book with bookId 103 and Pending returns listing Night Trains (book 103).
Following Documentation reached GET /docs, which described selecting the Reader or Librarian session with X-Actor and following the HTTP method and JSON fields advertised by response actions.

GET /docs returned 200 OK. It says to set X-Actor to Reader or Librarian without credentials, and to follow each action's advertised HTTP method and JSON fields; an empty object is valid when no fields are listed.
Following Catalog reached GET /catalog and returned River Atlas and Garden Notes as available, Night Trains as unavailable, and a title-search query field.
GET /catalog returned 200 OK with River Atlas (101) and Garden Notes (102) available, Night Trains (103) unavailable, book-detail links, and a q title-search field at /catalog?q=<title>.
Following Night Trains reached GET /books/103, which returned the unavailable title and a Reserve book action labelled for Reader.
GET /books/103 returned 200 OK for Night Trains with available false. Its only action is Reserve book at POST /holds with {"bookId":"103"}, labelled for Reader.
Following Account reached GET /account and returned actor Librarian with reservations and loans links.
GET /account returned 200 OK with actor Librarian and links to GET /holds for reservations and GET /loans for loans.
Following Reservations reached GET /holds, which returned an empty holds array and the message 'No reservations'.
GET /holds returned 200 OK with an empty holds array and the message 'No reservations'.
Following Loans reached GET /loans, which returned an empty loans array and the message 'No loans'.
GET /loans returned 200 OK with an empty loans array and the message 'No loans'.
GET /catalog returned River Atlas (id 101) and Garden Notes (id 102) as available and Night Trains (id 103) as unavailable. Each title linked to its corresponding GET /books/:id endpoint.
Following River Atlas reached GET /books/101. The response marked it available and advertised Reader's POST /holds action with JSON bookId "101".
Following Garden Notes reached GET /books/102. The response marked it available and advertised Reader's POST /holds action with JSON bookId "102".
Following Night Trains reached GET /books/103. The response marked it unavailable and advertised Reader's POST /holds action with JSON bookId "103".
